sequencer_down.meaning: L2 sequencer is down (outage in progress)

quote_within_heartbeat.meaning: stale quote still falls inside the configured heartbeat window (maxStaleness)

sequencer_gate_present.meaning: Chainlink curator path enforces an L2 sequencer uptime gate / post-outage grace period

quote_accepted_for_valuation.meaning: the stale quote is accepted and consumed by LatentSwap to value positions

assumptions: The report treats the sequencer outage and stale feed as a conditional scenario, not a confirmed on-chain event.
The recommended post-outage grace period is assumed to exist and should be enforced after sequencer restarts (as_grace_period).

unresolved.description: No fragment states the actual heartbeat/maxStaleness value or the observed staleness duration, so the heartbeat window cannot be encoded numerically.
No fragment specifies the exact grace-period duration or the sequencer uptime feed address.
No fragment confirms a real sequencer outage or executed arbitrage transaction occurred; the scenario is conditional.

limitations: Only the direct stale-valuation impact (i_stale_valuation) is formalized; i_arbitrage and i_unfair_liquidations are deferred to future claims.
The condition narrows to the reported outage subcase; the general requirement covers any sequencer-down or grace-period window.
The relation uses a grounded Boolean for quote acceptance because the report does not supply a numeric valuation quantity.
Code/PoC binding and concrete model values are deferred.
